protocol: One independent complete reference-image-to-MP4 run per case, fresh ComfyUI process each time; no saved latent reuse; no node cache hits; server startup and validation excluded. OS cache was not cleared; another GPU workload continued.
upscaler: realesr-animevideov3.pth, FP16 channels_last, batch4, x4 then bicubic 0.5

validation.human_review: Author accepted the Sol output image quality for this case on 2026-10-29; this does not establish equivalence for all inputs.

note: Published examples use reference.png as a user-selected placeholder. Only the filename/output prefix differs from the executed graphs. This is not a 4070 measurement.
